say:1:1720921001:1.text: Miss, wait just a second! You look exhausted. Someone ought to rescue you from all this hard work.
say:1:1720921001:1.source_cn: 这位美丽的小姐，请留步！看你这么辛苦，真是让人心疼啊。

say:2:1720921002:1.text: Do you need something? If not, move.

say:3:1720921003:1.text: Hey, don't be in such a hurry. Hands like yours belong on a harp, not buried in chores. Is the viscount's household really so desperate for help that they've got you doing rough work like this?
say:3:1720921003:1.source_cn: 哎，别急着走嘛！你这双手，本该是用来弹奏竖琴的，现在却...

say:4:1720921004:1.text: What are you actually trying to say? I've still got work to finish, and if I fall behind again, the viscountess will have my head!
say:4:1720921004:1.source_cn: 你到底想说什么？我还有一大堆活没干完，再不把这些干完，...

say:5:1720921005:1.text: That's no way to treat a lady like you. Someone like you should be out in the garden with tea and pastries, not running errands all day. Speaking of tea, I heard...
say:5:1720921005:1.source_cn: 子爵夫人怎么能这么对你呢？像你这样可爱的小姐，就该在花...

say:6:1720921006:1.text: Are you done?! I don't know you, and I'm not here to chat about tea! Move, or I'm calling for help!
say:6:1720921006:1.source_cn: 你有完没完？！ 我不认识你，也不想聊什么下午茶！再不让...

say:7:1720921007:1.text: Alright, alright, no need to shout! Name's Maska. I'm a reporter, that's all. I just wanted to ask one small question. Has anyone unusual been around the manor lately?
say:7:1720921007:1.source_cn: 哎，别紧张嘛！我叫马斯卡，就是个跑腿写稿的。我就是想问...

say:8:1720921008:1.text: Yes. He's standing right in front of me. Loafing around, talking slick, keeping me from doing my job, and sticking his nose where it doesn't belong! You're the strangest person I've ever met!
say:8:1720921008:1.source_cn: 我眼前就站着一个，无所事事，油腔滑调，拦着别人不让人工...

say:9:1720921009:1.text: What? No, I'm just interviewing you!

say:10:1720921010:1.text: You look more like a creep with too much time on his hands! Move!
say:10:1720921010:1.source_cn: 我看你是个想偷懒的流氓！让开！
